table.name: frpm
table.purpose: Register of schools (one row per school) with location, classification and a block of performance counts and rates. Text values appear obfuscated by a letter-substitution cipher (e.g. 'Qdwfwgs Zxkrrc Swzpjwxp' decodes consistently to 'Country High School', 'Gcgvgdpojy' to 'Primary'), but the structure is clearly a school directory with attached performance statistics.

col_001.name: school_id
col_001.description: 14-digit unique record identifier, primary key of the table. Its digits embed the other ID parts: first 2 digits = col_003, next 5 = col_004, last 7 = col_005. Joins one-to-one to t03.col_001.

col_003.name: region_code
col_003.description: Two-digit area/region code (1-58, 58 distinct values). Equals the first two digits of col_001 and maps one-to-one with the 58 district names in col_006.

col_004.name: local_authority_code
col_004.description: Five-digit authority/district code (1012 distinct). Equals digits 3-7 of col_001 and corresponds to the authority names in col_007.

col_005.name: school_serial_number
col_005.description: Seven-digit serial number, nearly unique per row. Equals the last 7 digits of col_001; '0000000' appears 45 times (likely placeholder/unknown).

col_006.name: district_name
col_006.description: Name of the district/region (58 distinct values, matching col_003), e.g. 'Crz Odhgcgz' = 'Old Township' style names.

col_007.name: local_authority_name
col_007.description: Name of the local authority (1000 distinct values, matching col_004's code), e.g. 'Crz Odhgcgz Qdwfwgs' = 'Old Township Country'.

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: Name of the school (8652 distinct, near one per row), e.g. '...Gcgvgdpojy' = '...Primary'.

col_009.name: school_type
col_009.description: Broad school type/phase, 8 values, e.g. 'Qdwfwgs Zxkrrc Swzpjwxp' = 'Country High School', 'Gcgvgdpojy Zxkrrc Swzpjwxp' = 'Primary High School', 'Kwhk Zxkrrc Swzpjwxp' = 'High High School' (likely 'City/Urban High School').

col_010.name: school_category
col_010.description: More detailed school category (17 values), e.g. 'Gcgvgdpojy Zxkrrcz (Lqacwx)' = 'Primary Schools (Boarding?)', 'Xrdpwdqopwrd Kwhk Zxkrrcz' = 'International High Schools'.

col_011.name: governance_type
col_011.description: Governance/ownership classification (12 values), dominated by 'Pjoswpwrdoc' = 'Independent'; others like 'Xrdpwdqopwrd Zxkrrc' = 'International School', 'Ocpgjdopwig Zxkrrc rf Xkrwxg' = 'Departmental School of Science'.

col_012.name: religious_affiliation
col_012.description: Religious character/denomination, null for 81.5% (secular schools). Values like 'Ajgoefozp Ljriwzwrd 9' = 'Catholic Voluntary 9', 'XGL' likely 'CoE' (Church of England).

col_014.name: religious_character_code
col_014.description: Four-character code (e.g. '00D2', '0756'), null for 88.3% of rows — exactly the same rows as col_015, so it is the code counterpart of the religious/ethos status in col_015. Exact coding scheme unknown.

col_015.name: religious_status
col_015.description: Religious/ethos status, null for 88.3% of rows: 'Swjgxpcy fqdsgs' = 'Minority status', 'Crxoccy fqdsgs' = 'Catholic status', one row 'Drp wd XZ fqdswdh vrsgc' = 'Not in ... faith school'.

col_019.name: count_measure_1
col_019.description: Integer count, 1-5333, median ~528. Part of the first count/rate pair (with col_020/col_021). Likely a pupil/exam count for one measure (e.g. total entries or pupils in a subject), but the exact measure is not determinable.

col_020.name: count_measure_1_subset
col_020.description: Integer count, 1-3927, always <= col_019 in samples. Likely the successful/subset count corresponding to col_019.

col_021.name: rate_measure_1
col_021.description: Proportion in (0,1], consistent with col_020/col_019 (e.g. 54/102 = 0.529 = col_021 in row 1). Rate/proportion for the first measure pair.

col_022.name: count_measure_2
col_022.description: Integer count, 1-4419, second count/rate pair (with col_023). Likely another subject/measure count.

col_023.name: rate_measure_2
col_023.description: Proportion in (0,1], consistent with col_022/col_019 (e.g. 63/102 = 0.6176 = col_023 in row 1). Rate for the second measure pair.

col_024.name: count_measure_3
col_024.description: Integer count, 1-5271, third count/rate pair (with col_025/col_026).

col_025.name: count_measure_3_subset
col_025.description: Integer count, 1-3864, subset count corresponding to col_024 (e.g. 40/73 = 0.5479 = col_026 in row 1).

col_026.name: rate_measure_3
col_026.description: Proportion in (0,1], equal to col_025/col_024 in samples. Rate for the third measure pair.

col_027.name: count_measure_4_subset
col_027.description: Integer count, 1-4347, fourth measure pair (with col_028); in samples equals col_025 or close to it (e.g. 46/73 = 0.6301 = col_028 in row 1).

col_028.name: rate_measure_4
col_028.description: Proportion in (0,1], equal to col_027/col_024 in samples. Rate for the fourth measure pair.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: A registry of financial institutions (banks): one row per institution, keyed by a 14-digit identifier that joins one-to-one to t03. Contains anonymized institution and contact names, a country/region field, a two-value code, and several numeric metrics (large counts and mid-range scores). Text values appear to be cipher/anonymized, so exact real-world labels cannot be recovered, but the structural roles are clear.

col_001.name: institution_id
col_001.description: 14-digit unique identifier for each institution (primary key of the table). All values distinct, no nulls. Joins one-to-one to t03.col_001, so t03 carries per-institution detail keyed by this ID. The specific coding scheme (e.g., national bank code vs. internal ID) is not determinable.

col_003.name: contact_person_name
col_003.description: Anonymized person names (mostly 2-3 tokens, some with initials and middle tokens, a few with parenthesized acronyms), 23% null, near-unique. Likely the name of a person associated with the institution (e.g., director, manager, or registered agent). The ciphered text prevents confirming the exact role.

col_004.name: institution_name
col_004.description: Anonymized institution names. 520 distinct values; the most frequent values end with the same token seen in col_003 names (likely 'Bank'), and several values are longer descriptive names ('... Rffwxg rf Gsqxopwrd' resembles '... Company of ...'). Almost certainly the legal/registered name of the institution.

col_005.name: country_or_region
col_005.description: Anonymized geographic label with 57 distinct values; the top value ('Crz Odhgcgz', 467 rows) is also the prefix of the most frequent institution name in col_004, indicating a country/region name (e.g., 'Germany' / 'German ...'). Low-cardinality geographic categorization of the institutions.

col_008.name: score_1
col_008.description: Integer in a narrow 308-653 band (mean ~480), null for 26% of rows (the same rows missing col_009-col_011). The 300-700 range is typical of credit/rating scores, and the shared null pattern suggests these columns come from a secondary source populated only for a subset of institutions. Exact scale unknown.

col_009.name: score_2
col_009.description: Integer in 289-699 (mean ~484), null on exactly the same 26% of rows as col_008/col_010/col_011. A second score on a similar scale; likely paired with col_008 (e.g., two rating dimensions or min/max of a score). Meaning not confirmable.

col_010.name: score_3
col_010.description: Integer in 312-671 (mean ~473), null on the same 26% of rows as col_008/col_009. Third score in the same family; values track col_008/col_009 closely. Likely another rating/score component for the same subset of institutions.

table.name: schools
table.purpose: Directory of California public schools and districts (CDE-style schools directory): one row per school/site, keyed by a 14-digit CDS code, with location, contact, grade-span, and administrative attributes. Text values appear obfuscated/letter-substituted, but structure (CDS codes, 'XO'=state code, county/district/school hierarchy, grade spans, CA lat/long) is clear.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code; unique primary key, referenced one-to-one by t01 and t02. First 2 digits county, next 5 district, last 7 school.

col_002.name: county_district_code
col_002.description: 7-digit county+district code (first 7 digits of the CDS code); identifies the LEA the school belongs to.

col_003.name: school_code
col_003.description: School-level code (last digits of CDS), unique within a district; null for district/office rows.

col_004.name: status_type
col_004.description: Entity status with 4 values (dominant value ~66%); likely Active/Closed/Merged/Pending status of the record. Exact code meanings unresolved due to obfuscation.

col_005.name: county_name
col_005.description: County name (58 distinct values, matching California's 58 counties; top value ~ Los Angeles).

col_007.name: school_name
col_007.description: School/site name; highly unique, includes type suffixes like 'Elementary', 'High School'.

col_008.name: street_address
col_008.description: Physical street address (full form, e.g. '1234 Main Street').

col_009.name: street_address_abbrev
col_009.description: Physical street address with abbreviated suffixes (St., Ave., Blvd.); abbreviated variant of col_008.

col_011.name: zip_code
col_011.description: Physical address ZIP code, 5-digit or ZIP+9 format.

col_012.name: state_code
col_012.description: Physical address state; constant 'XO' (obfuscated two-letter state code, i.e. CA).

col_013.name: mailing_street_address
col_013.description: Mailing street address (full form); near-duplicate of physical address for most rows.

col_014.name: mailing_street_address_abbrev
col_014.description: Mailing street address with abbreviated suffixes.

col_016.name: mailing_zip_code
col_016.description: Mailing address ZIP code (5-digit or ZIP+9).

col_018.name: phone_number
col_018.description: Contact phone number in '(XXX) XXX-XXXX' format; null for ~34% of rows.

col_019.name: phone_extension
col_019.description: Sparse numeric field associated with phone contact; plausibly a phone extension or secondary number, but values (0–630100) are too varied to confirm.

col_020.name: website_url
col_020.description: Website URL (obfuscated domain, 'kppl://' = http://, '.rjh'/'.dgp' = .org/.net); null for ~61%.

col_021.name: open_date
col_021.description: Date the school opened/record established; dominant default value 2036-07-01 (obfuscated placeholder), range 1906–2073. Could alternatively be a 'status change date'.

col_022.name: closed_date
col_022.description: Date the school closed (null for ~68% of rows, i.e. still open); dominant value 2045-06-30 suggests a batch closure date.

col_023.name: charter_flag
col_023.description: 0/1 flag, ~10.6% true — consistent with the share of charter schools in California; plausibly a charter school indicator.

col_025.name: charter_funding_type
col_025.description: Applies to charter rows only: values decode to 'Direct funded', 'Locally funded', and a third 'not applicable' variant — charter funding type.

col_026.name: educational_level_code
col_026.description: Code for the entity's educational level/type (54=Unified School District, 52=Elementary School District, 00=County Office of Education, 56=Middle School District, etc.); pairs with col_027.

col_027.name: educational_level_label
col_027.description: Label for col_026: 'Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)', 'Middle School District', 'Juvenile Court School (JCS)' etc.

col_028.name: school_type_code
col_028.description: Code for school type (60=Elementary Schools (Public), 66=Middle Schools, 62=Junior High, 68=K-12, etc.); pairs with col_029.

col_029.name: school_type_label
col_029.description: Label for col_028: 'Elementary Schools (Public)', 'Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools', 'County Office of Education schools', etc.

col_030.name: school_category_code
col_030.description: Short code (e.g. 'PJOS' covering ~57% of non-null rows) for the school's category/type; pairs with col_031. Exact code meanings unresolved due to obfuscation.

col_031.name: school_category_label
col_031.description: Label for col_030 (e.g. most common value is the main 'regular school' category; others include 'County Community School', 'Community Day School', 'County Office of Education School').

col_032.name: grade_span_served_code
col_032.description: Code for grade span served (GCGV='Elementary', KZ='Middle School', GCGVKWHK='Elementary-Middle', QH='Charters', etc.); pairs with col_033.

col_033.name: grade_span_served_label
col_033.description: Label for col_032: 'Elementary', 'Middle School', 'Charters', 'Intermediate/Junior/Middle Middle', 'Elementary-Middle Combination'.

col_034.name: low_grade
col_034.description: Lowest grade served, using codes where 'E' = elementary/pre-K and digits are grade levels ('1-89' likely grades 1 through 8/9 combined coding).

col_035.name: high_grade
col_035.description: Highest grade served, same coding scheme as col_034 ('E-0', 'E-4', '1-89', '86-89').

col_038.name: latitude
col_038.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (32.5–44.2, consistent with California).

col_039.name: longitude
col_039.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-124.3 to -83.8, mostly -117 to -122, consistent with California).

col_040.name: location_county
col_040.description: County name of the geocoded location (same vocabulary as col_005); null where lat/long missing.

col_041.name: location_city
col_041.description: City of the geocoded location; null where lat/long missing.

col_043.name: contact_first_name
col_043.description: First name of an administrative contact (sparse, ~2.4% populated).

col_044.name: contact_last_name
col_044.description: Last name of an administrative contact (sparse).

col_045.name: contact_email
col_045.description: Email of the administrative contact (sparse); pairs with col_043/col_044.

col_046.name: alt_contact_first_name
col_046.description: First name of a second/rare contact (only ~40 rows); likely another administrator contact.

col_047.name: alt_contact_last_name
col_047.description: Last name of the second/rare contact.

col_049.name: last_update_date
col_049.description: Record update/revision date; two dominant batch dates (2071-06-18 and 2055-06-24) suggest bulk updates rather than open/close dates.
